description: Discover MCP servers matching a need, ranked by semantic similarity over a curated snapshot of observed MCP servers - free, no account, no payment. Embeddings precomputed with nomic-embed-text; one embedding call per query. Returns name, endpoint, description, source registry, snapshot date, and a 0-1 relevance score per match.
name: discover_mcp_servers
title: Discover Mcp Servers
